integrity.scientific_validation_limit: No independent audit; originality assessed against inspected accessible literature and indexed records.

limitations: Requires integer redundancy tending to infinity and the specific real normalized two-sided-exponential window.
Does not address other totally positive functions, nonrectangular optimal lattices, or finite-dimensional sampling.
Uses the previously published global optimizer uniqueness theorem and exact frame-bound formulas.
Some older unindexed quantitative Gabor literature may contain equivalent asymptotics.
scientific_scope: Sharp high-redundancy optimizer and condition-number asymptotics for a normalized two-sided-exponential Gabor window on rectangular integer-density lattices; original finite-density formulas and uniqueness are used as known results.
title: High-density logarithmic balancing for optimal two-sided-exponential Gabor frames
